decisions.reason: Replacing ordinary content controls with simple text may make grey field cues obsolete for those locations, but the source does not establish whether cues should be removed, replaced, or retained for specialized controls.

Simple manually editable text could replace click-to-clear placeholder behavior, but the evidence does not establish that the specific Board Recommendation field is included in the ordinary-text change.
The Title field may become simple text rather than an interactive control, but the source does not identify that field or determine whether its formatting-preservation requirement changes.
Choosing simple text for ordinary editable content does not alter the required Windows environment or general reliability and multi-user stability expectations.
The ordinary editable-text mechanism does not change bullet sizing, appearance, alignment, scaling, or level-9 color requirements.
The simple-text decision does not change the requirement to include the specified theme colors.
The source concerns ordinary document text, not the specialized controlled bullet area where pressing Enter creates a new bullet.
Using simple text for ordinary editable content does not resolve or modify the requirements governing pasted legacy content and style stability.
The source does not change pasted-table stability or right-hand column containment.
